name: run_evo2_variant_effect
description: Zero-shot variant-effect scoring with NVIDIA-hosted Evo 2 (Arc Institute genome foundation model, 1 Mb context). Runs the model's forward pass on the reference and alternate DNA windows and returns the delta log-likelihood (alt - ref). Negative = variant disfavored by the genome model (candidate deleterious); near-zero = tolerated. Served as a remote MCP tool so the hosted NIM call and NVIDIA_API_KEY live on the server. Complements NvidiaNIM_evo2 (which only generates sequences). Provide ref_sequence+alt_sequence (same length) or sequence+position+alternate.

NVIDIA_API_KEY.purpose: Call NVIDIA NIM model endpoints (hosted inference for bio/chem models).
NVIDIA_API_KEY.without: NIM tools are blocked without it.

ref_sequence.description: Reference DNA window (A/C/G/T/N). Use with alt_sequence (same length).

alt_sequence.description: Alternate DNA window, same length/centering as ref_sequence.

sequence.description: Reference DNA window for point-substitution mode (use with position + alternate).

position.description: 1-based position of the substituted base within `sequence`.

reference.description: Optional reference base (single letter) at `position`, validated against `sequence`.

error.description: Error description if the run failed.
